Surf weeks for every level

Just a few steps from the ocean, find Global Surf Lodge Kabalana – a wild oasis where footwear is discouraged, chilling out is inescapable, and good times never stop.

We are surfing obsessed, and we invite you to join us and experience a perfect blend of wild tropical views and great surfing for all levels. Next set is yours!

Three levels, one week each

Level 1 needs no surfing experience. Level 2 is for intermediate surfers, Level 3 for advanced ones.

The rooms

Take a bed in the four-bed mixed dorm and the package price is all you pay, tax included. The shared twin room costs more, and having it to yourselves costs more again. The booking engine shows how much for your dates. Every level package in the engine also comes with seven days of unlimited equipment use.

Check-in 14:00 to 20:00, check-out by 11:00. Packages start on a Saturday and run 7, 14, 21 or 28 nights. You must be 18 or over to book a package online. No pets.

A day at the camp

Grab your board and head out with your group for a refreshing morning surf session. A big, healthy breakfast will be waiting for you when you get back.

Afterwards, you can either relax at the lodge or explore the extraordinary surrounds before heading out for your afternoon surf. End your day with an epic dinner together with the other guests and soak up the electric aloha vibes.

The lodge

At Global Surf Lodge Kabalana, we provide our guests with a unique, holistic stay which combines surf, yoga & wellness, local culture, and nature.

The rooms are spread around the garden, each one apart from the others. The pool has sunbeds under the palms, and there's a bar and a laid-back common area too. One guest on Booking.com called the place “something inbetween a hostel and a luxurious hotel”. On the same site the staff get 9.5 out of 10, across 80 reviews.

The waves and the season

Beach breaks, points and reefs a few steps from the lodge, and more waves a few minutes away by tuk-tuk.

The main season runs from October to April. May to September is the low season.

Getting here

Colombo airport is about two and a half hours away by road. There's an airport shuttle, for an extra charge.

Cross the Matara road and you're on the beach at Kathaluwa West, 40 metres from the lodge. Kabalana Beach is 350 metres away.

Booking.com's house rules list cash as the accepted payment method.
